_comment: Daily ATM issuance of the $100-par preferreds, keyed by ET date then ticker. Source: @STRC_live daily wraps on X. The scheduled @STRC_live checker should append each trading day here and push. A day with shares_sold > 0 at/near par (high >= peg.atm.min_high, close >= peg.atm.min_close) counts as a qualifying day for FLYWHEEL ON (that ON then persists under the usual off rules). STRC sales turn the buyback flag OFF and keep it off until a later 8-K week ending after that ATM date shows buybacks with no sales.
